quest.title: Tatara Tales: Priority Investigation
quest.description: Xavier, who is researching the Mikage Furnace, seems to have had some new idea...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: #Hello there, my dear, gallant {F#girl}{M#boy}! I have good news and bad news regarding the Mikage Furnace. Which would you like to hear first?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: The good news is that the core's only suffered some minor damage. It is still within my power to fix it.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: The bad news, however, is that the Fatui poking around in there don't seem to appreciate this piece of good news.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: They very much seem to be searching for a way to get their grubby hands on the Tatarigami core.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: But if we let them meddle any further, the Tatarigami's power will get out of control. This entire island will be blown sky-high with us still on it.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: However, if we focus solely on the Fatui, the Tatarigami energy built up inside the containment dome will eventually reach its limit all the same...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So we need to deal with both of them at the same time?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Well... Put simply, academically speaking, in an objective sense...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: We are facing two separate problems here: the Fatui and the Tatarigami.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: But with how the situation is inside the Mikage Furnace, whichever problem we choose to tackle, we're likely to have to face the other in the process.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: So, ultimately, the fact of the matter is—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You mean to say, "yes."

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Um, yes, that's correct. We need to deal with both of them at the same time.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: But one step at a time. As the Liyue saying goes, "don't rush to eat hot tofu, or you'll burn your tongue."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How come you know Liyue proverbs?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: We've been to Liyue before. I'd consider this little gem of wisdom a souvenir from the trip.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I have a lot more of these souvenirs where that one came from. I must confess to having imbibed all of my "souvenirs" from Mondstadt, though... they were really very good.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Let's get back on track. I have a teensy-tiny plan to fix this Mikage Furnace situation, but I will need your help.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Ha! Forthright and ready for a fight! That's what I like about you!

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Ahem. I digress. Now, hold on to these Sensor Beacons, if you please.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I need you to place them in a number of locations for me.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: What these Sensor Beacons will do is gather data on the density and distribution of Tatarigami energy within the Mikage Furnace. Once armed with this data, I should be able to come up with a more detailed plan.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I shall leave it in your hands, indeed.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I will mark the locations for the beacons on your map. I'll be counting on you, Traveler!

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: The simplest way to explain it is that they are instruments that use elemental power to quantify and calculate all other sorts of energy.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Well, I say "simple," but it's not actually that easy to explain... But I suppose we could start from the theory of the seven elements! Now then—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No, no, you don't need to go on.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Well, as you wish.

choices.text: Well, what do I get out of this?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Hmm... how about the undiscovered treasures of this island, and some "leftover materials" from inside the Mikage Furnace?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I'm sure there must some things of note inside the Mikage Furnace, what with it being the largest smelting facility in Inazuma and all.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Of course, as someone who does not possess a Vision, I am unable to enter the Mikage Furnace at present, nor would I really know about what's going on in there.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: The bad news is that the Fatui are still poking around inside the Furnace.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: They very much seem to be searching for a way to get their grubby hands on the Tatarigami core.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: The good news is that the core hasn't suffered much damage, so I can take care of it myself.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Obviously, the Fatui will be none too pleased to hear that.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Well done, now all we have to do is to let them collect the data.

choices.text: How did you know where to put them?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I was part of the design team for the Mikage Furnace. By placing beacons in these locations, we can gather data on almost all the areas inside.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Hmm, you know, if we set up purifying devices in these locations, our troubles would be over overnight.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: If Mr. Flois knew half of what had happened here, he'd go completely ballistic...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Alright, thanks for your help. Please take these as compensation.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Ahem, one other thing... I may possibly, probably, definitely need you to help me retrieve the beacons again at some point over the next few days.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I don't have a Vision, after all, so I can't simply stroll into somewhere with such a high concentration of Tatarigami energy.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Not to mention that those, hmm, rough-and-tough Fatui folks are still there. I honestly think you are the only person on this whole island capable of dealing with them and the furnace at the same time.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: You jest! Even if I sold them to you, what would I use then?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Seriously, though, if you ever visit Fontaine, I can put you in touch with someone who will sell them to you at a very fair price.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Hopefully this is as far as the situation escalates... If we go on like this, we'll have a diplomatic incident on our hands and no mistake!

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Well done, now all we have to do is let them collect the data.

choices.text: How did you know where to put them?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: I was part of the design team for the Mikage Furnace. By placing beacons in these locations, we can gather data on almost all the areas inside.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: *sigh* If we could have put Purifiers there instead of Sensor Beacons, we could pretty much solve the problem overnight.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: If Mr. Flois knew half of what had happened here, he'd go completely ballistic...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Alright, thanks for your help. Please take these as compensation.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: *cough*... Umm... Also, I might need to bother you with retrieving the beacons in a few days.

response.text: I don't have a Vision, after all, so I can't simply stroll into somewhere with such a high concentration of Tatarigami energy.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Seriously, though, if you ever visit Fontaine, I can put you in touch with someone who will sell them to you at a very fair price.
